extraction_notes: Main-text catalytic performance plots are Figures 7, 8, and 9; all show methanol STY as bar charts at 230, 250, 270, 290, and 310 °C. Figures 1–6 and 10 are characterization/non-performance and were skipped. Main-text conversion/selectivity performance data are described only as Supporting Information figures (e.g., S20, S22), so they were not digitised here. Figure 7 and Figure 8 both replot the h-ZrO2@Cu1.3ZnAl1.6-LDH per-Cu STY series; both plotted occurrences are retained. Values are approximate reads from bar tops; error bars were not digitised.
